title: [29.x[All-e]Payment Discount with Prices Incl. VAT provides unexpected results in the Spanish version
summary: Spanish version payment discount calculation corrected for prices including VAT by accounting for payment discount amount when recalculating VAT base.
key_points: Payment discounts now correctly reflected in sales and purchase totals when prices include VAT
VAT-inclusive branch now subtracts payment discount amount during VAT base recalculation
VAT-exclusive calculations left unchanged to preserve existing behavior
Addresses issue when VAT base discount percentage and EC amount are zero
Comprehensive test coverage added for payment discount scenarios
quote: Subtract "Pmt. Discount Amount" when recalculating the VAT base in the VAT-inclusive branch.
